# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by display name."""
    roster = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    if not roster:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    rows = []
    for student in roster:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for {student.display_name}")
        rows.append(f"{student.display_name:<20} {student.section:<8} {student.email}")
    return rows
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows(
            [
                Student("2", "Young", "Zed", "B", "zed@example.org"),
                Student("1", "Adams", "Amy", "A", "amy@example.org")
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            rows,
            [
                "Adams, Amy           A        amy@example.org",
                "Young, Zed           B        zed@example.org"
            ]
        )

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([Student("1", "Adams", "Amy", "A")])
        self.assertIn("Adams, Amy", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
